correctness.rationale: Cross-product rigidity from e1 e_(d+1)=0 forces at most one nonterminal nonzero coordinate of f(e1), with other images fixed by squaring. Ranks follow from independent leading basis coordinates. Any nonunit raises the terminal support filtration V_r=span(e_r,...,e_n), so arbitrary products of n nonunits vanish, not merely individual powers; the shift T(e_i)=e_(i+1) has T^(n-1)≠0, proving sharp joint ideal index. Closure under composition follows from rank monotonicity in the finite-dimensional endomorphism monoid. Idempotents 0 and 1 then force regular elements exactly units and zero: f g f=f implies fg idempotent; if fg=0 then f=0, if fg=1 then f unit. Independent separate generator-image checks for n=2,3,4 over F2 and n=3 over F3 found all rank counts, only 2 idempotents and max composition nilpotency n. Universal ideal result is proved from filtration, not sampled.

However, the companion current assignment chain-endomorphism package proves exactly the same unrestricted normal form and rank counts over all fields, so those parts cannot receive independent originality credit here. The distinguished new claim is the *joint* nilpotence of the entire nonunit two-sided ideal with exact index n and regular-element spectrum; the other manuscript asserts each nonunit individually nilpotent but not the sharp semigroup ideal.
